content.comment_body: This example demonstrates a Master-Master connection that can be expanded to include more [product_name] modules. The program uses ladder diagrams, catering to users who prefer this method. Signal mapping is organized by type for better clarity. Some users may find helpful tips in this example for their own projects. Regards, [user_name]

I have provided an example for connecting four [product_name] modules. A significant advantage is using local VM mapping, as it simplifies future IP address changes. This update is only needed in the Ethernet connections, avoiding the need to revise every mapping in each program, which saves time and reduces errors. Please refer to the JPG file for a network overview showing relationships between client, server, and TSAP. If any mistakes are found, please let me know. Regards, [user_name]

analysis.insight_summary: Participants discuss scalable Master-Master connections with multiple [product_name] modules using ladder diagrams, emphasizing the practicality of local VM mapping. This method streamlines future IP address changes within Ethernet connections, enhancing manageability and minimizing errors and reconfiguration efforts in large setups.
analysis.user_expectations: Users are looking for a clear, scalable solution to configuring and updating networks with multiple [product_name] modules. They want an error-resistant approach that allows for easy updates to IP address mappings without requiring extensive program modifications.
